text: Ingoapele Madingoane's Africa My Beginning was banned in South Africa on 9 May 1979 under section 47(2)(e) of the Publications Act 1974 as prejudicial to State security and good order. The 22-poem collection invoked Sharpeville and Soweto, called on ancestors for liberation, and praised declared communists (Neto, Mugabe).
